     5	/-- Exact Horner evaluation of coefficients in increasing degree order. -/
     6	def P : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
     7	  | [], _ => 0

    11	at every list step, including the last coefficient. -/

    13	  | [], _ => 0
    14	  | a :: tail, x => model.round (a + model.round (x * Q model tail x))

    16	/-- The prescribed error envelope, independent of the rounding operation. -/
    17	def E : List ℝ → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ
    18	  | [], _, _ => 0
    19	  | a :: tail, x, u =>
    20	      let v := P tail x
    21	      let e := E tail x u
    22	      u * |a + x * v| + (1 + u) * (u * |x * v| + (1 + u) * |x| * e)

    24	/-- Rounding error relative to an arbitrary exact reference. -/
